content.summary: U.K. regulators cleared a multiple myeloma drug GSK withdrew from market three years ago. Elsewhere, RNA editing startup Airna tapped a former Sarepta executive to oversee its pipeline.

content.title: Elevation Oncology Plunges 42% on Ending Development of Lead Drug
content.summary: ELEV decides to stop developing its lead drug after disappointing data from an early-stage study evaluating its sole clinical-stage drug in gastric cancers.

content.title: Elevation Oncology downgraded as it halts lead asset on disappointing trials
content.summary: Investing.com -- Wall Street cut rating on Elevation Oncology Inc (NASDAQ:ELEV) after the company announced it will discontinue development of its lead asset, EO-3021, due to disappointing efficacy in a Phase 1 trial. Analysts now see limited near-term catalysts, with Elevation pivoting to its HER3-targeted ADC, EO-1022, which is still in preclinical development.
